signature: A vaporwave desert of yellow and violet sand under a giant sliced sun that never finishes setting over a still, net-lined sea: half-buried purple marble temples with neon rings and dial-up terminals, a Digital Trench of floating hyperlink windows you walk down to, a Neon City of endless night, and music so calm that standing still too long turns you into static.

entity_policy: SOURCED ONLY, never combat: Static Ghosts (harmless; stare at the sun, lie on the sand, stand on city sidewalks, wave to each other), Binary Fish (schools of digit-skeleton fish; linger near one underwater and they nip for 8 damage), Light Traffic (red light streaks on the city roads, stopped by red lights; touching one is fatal). Windows (the hotel-window entity) not implemented: the hotel interior is not modelled. No Partygoers (page: none sighted).
notes: SOURCE: desert of yellow and violet sand, Web Sea at the warm edge, Neon City at the cold edge, barren unclimbable mountains east and west; sun 6x size, orange-pink, sliced in horizontal lines, fixed setting over the sea; white line grid on a sky from orange to deep purple; background music different for each wanderer (lounge, smooth jazz, slowed); Cool Desert temples of purple marble half-buried, statues, busts, murals, neon rings round columns, dial-up terminals on courtyard floors; potted plants, palms only at oases below sea level; floating geometric shapes; Sunset Coast; intangible breathable unswimmable water; Web Sea net lines, blue to purple, 500 m deep Digital Trenches with hyperlink windows (safe 1,3,4,5,7,25,31,87; broken 0,2,6,8,17,58 to the Null); Binary Fish; Neon City always night, towers, hotels, malls (marble tiles, glass roofs, neon rings, closed stores, open arcades on free play, ball pits to avoid, vending machines), TVs, Light Traffic stopped by red lights, rain up to 15 minutes; Tune-Out into Static Ghosts, an alarm clock as outside noise prevents it; M.E.G. Base Zeta abandoned near a temple. ADAPTATION: the world is a ~600 m north-south slice (sea and trench 70 m, coast, a 150 m desert, a 150 m city) between mountain walls; the trench floor is 9 m below the surface (page: 500 m); the sea floor ends at an unclimbable submerged cliff at z -330; the music is an original synthesized loop seeded per run; Tune-Out fills over ~50 s of standing still and is fatal at full; the team's clock at Base Zeta rings every 40 s; the arcade cabinet alternates between Level 40 and Level 25 every 4 s; TV and cabinet exits are created once you enter the city; Light Traffic cycle 20 s; city rain 1-2.5 min; the Null and TV channels are release-boundary EXT destinations; the hotel is a lobby front only. Window placement and level-page text are ours (titles come from the registry).
